name: qr-scanner
description: High-performance QR code scanner using the native Barcode Detection API with multi-camera support and customizable UI
author: JasonJS Framework

QRScanner.description: QR code scanner modal with camera access, multi-camera switching, and real-time detection

onScan.description: Called with scanned QR code value (string)

successMessage.description: Success message shown after successful scan

autoCloseDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before auto-closing on success (set to 0 to disable)

barcode_detection_api.description: Uses the native Barcode Detection API available in Chrome, Edge, and Samsung Internet
barcode_detection_api.fallback: Shows error message if not supported
